Name: Vanilla Pepper Tweak
Author: HellaGayJaime
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]If you've ever grown your own peppers from seed IRL, you know that they take a really long time to germinate! This mod attempts to make Hot Peppers *slightly* more realistic, but also more lucrative.[/size][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Hot Pepper crops will now take 16 days to mature, spending a whopping 4 days in the seed stage. Once mature, they'll still regrow every 3 days, but you'll get 3 peppers per harvest, with the same chance for an extra harvest. [/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Hot Pepper base price increased to 60g (from 40g). This makes it slightly more profitable to roleplay as a grocery supplier, for those who don't want to get bored maxing out their profit on a single item.[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Putting Hot Pepper in a Keg will produce Hot Sauce. Hot Sauce is a drinkable Artisan Good with a base price of 320g (448g with the Artisan profession). It takes the same amount of time to process as Pale Ale. However, it cannot be aged in the cask. This provides a balanced alternative to Hops, whose trellises and daily harvesting can be annoying.[/size][/color][/*]
[/list]
This content pack may conflict with other mods that effect crop growth, pepper sale price, and keg outputs. 
[color=#ff0000][b]I AM NEW TO MODDING[/b][/color] 
Please report bugs and feedback is appreciated! Feel free to translate or take anything from this mod.

Long-Term Goals & Ideas:
[list]
[*]Making Hot Sauce a loved gift for the two guys who already love Hot Pepper. Should be easy.[/*]
[*]Making it give the best response at the Luau[/*]
[*]Adding new types of peppers sold by the island trader?[/*]
[*]Doing other vanilla tweaks[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Simply unzip in your Mods folder and you're ready to grow.[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]thanks to [url=https://stardewmodding.wiki.gg/]Stardew Modding Wiki[/url] for their tutorials[/color][/size]

[color=#666666][size=3][i]Trivia: The hot sauce sprite is based on Crystal hot sauce[/i][/size][/color]
